Package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.display

Interface PacketFactory<T>

public interface PacketFactory<T>
A generic class representing a PacketFactory that can create packets of type T. This class can be extended to provide specific implementations for creating packets based on different versions or criteria.
Since:
6.2.0.9
Author:
creatorfromhell

      T createTextDisplaySpawnPacket(int id, @NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.Location location)
      Creates a text display spawn packet for the specified entity ID and location.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier for the entity associated with the text display spawn packet

    • createTextDisplayVisiblePacket

      T createTextDisplayVisiblePacket(int id, @NotNull @NotNull Shop shop, @NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack itemStack)
      Creates a packet to toggle the visibility of a text display entity. This packet is associated with the specified entity ID, includes the provided item stack.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the entity whose visibility is being toggled
      itemStack - the item stack associated with the text display, must not be null
      Returns:
      a packet of type T that toggles the visibility of the text display
